bestiary.title: Goblin journal
goblin.grunt.name: Grunt
goblin.grunt.desc: The backbone of every horde. Weak alone, dangerous by the hundred.
goblin.runner.name: Runner
goblin.runner.desc: Fast and fragile. Slips through the gaps while turrets are still turning.
goblin.shield.name: Shield-bearer
goblin.shield.desc: Armour shrugs off bolts and bullets. Explosions crack it open.
goblin.brute.name: Brute
goblin.brute.desc: Slow, huge and stubborn. A single breakthrough hurts the base badly.
goblin.shaman.name: Shaman
goblin.shaman.desc: Heals wounded goblins around it. Take it down first.
goblin.glider.name: Glider
goblin.glider.desc: Flies over rocks, forest and water straight to the base. Mortars and tar can't hit it.
goblin.boss.name: Chieftain
goblin.boss.desc: The leader of the horde. Barely slows down and scatters a mob of grunts when it falls.
hud.sight.yes: Needs a clear line of sight
turret.ballista.desc: Long, narrow sector. Heavy bolts hit one goblin at a time.
turret.mortar.desc: Lobs shells over walls into crowds. Can't hit goblins right next to it.
turret.gatling.desc: Very fast, weak shots. Shreds runners and swarms.
turret.tar.desc: Throws tar that burns and slows everything in the puddle.
turret.tesla.desc: Short range, all around. Lightning jumps between goblins.
turret.beam.desc: A constant laser that pierces the whole line.
tutorial.rocket: Tap the map to fire a rocket from the base. Hold to keep firing
